warnings: The 2023 zoning map labels the district 'I'; the ordinance calls it I-1.
Zoning values come from an unofficial copy of the code. Verify with the township before relying on them.
The lot appears to be deeded to the road centerline, so front setbacks are measured from an assumed right-of-way line (state road 60 ft wide, local 50 ft). Confirm the real right-of-way.
A residential zoning district is within 150 ft of the parcel; the ordinance keeps buildings 150 ft from residential districts. This is not cut out of the buildable area yet.
1 mapped wetland area(s) touch the parcel (4.8 ac). They are not cut out of the buildable area; NWI mapping is not a delineation.
Existing buildings: the data source did not answer, so this is UNKNOWN, not 'none'. Run the packager again later to fill it in.
Floodplain (FEMA flood map): the data source did not answer, so this is UNKNOWN, not 'none'. Run the packager again later to fill it in.

More than one LiDAR survey covers this site (2017, 2024). USGS's combined ground surface does not say which one it used here, so the terrain date is not certain. Check for building pads in the 3D view.

frontSetbackFt.note: Measured from the road right-of-way. 150 ft when across the street from a residential district.

residentialSeparationFt.note: No building within 150 ft of a residentially zoned district.

maxHeightFt.note: Chimneys, towers, tanks and mechanical appurtenances up to 125 ft.

parkingRatios.rule: 1 space per 2 employees on the combined two largest successive shifts

derived.method: Parcel minus a round-ended buffer of each lot line by its setback; front setbacks are measured from the (assumed) road right-of-way line. Wetland buffers and residential separations are not subtracted.
